g.text: Products of sums: successful checking cost and all outcomes
Only consistently proved cases appear in cost curves; failures remain in the outcome strip.
P = proved; B = internal budget; U = unresolved; T = timeout; E = error; M = mixed.
Five runs; min/max whiskers; algebraic policy; fixed budgets; 30 s timeout. CLI report output included.
